rows.ARS:
Deep pink Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Justice of the Peace
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2012 as 'Justice of the Peace'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Large, double (17-25 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
